In the Go+React codebase at /bench/repo, find where the memo entity is defined at each of these layers:

1. SQL schema (CREATE TABLE for memo)
2. Go store model (struct definition in the store package)
3. API proto message (protobuf definition)
4. Generated frontend types (TypeScript types generated from proto)

Search strategies:
```
grep -rn "CREATE TABLE.*memo" /bench/repo --include="*.sql"
grep -rn "type Memo struct" /bench/repo --include="*.go"
grep -rn "message Memo " /bench/repo --include="*.proto"
find /bench/repo -name "*.ts" -path "*/generated/*" | head -20
find /bench/repo -name "*.ts" -path "*proto*" | head -20
grep -rn "interface Memo" /bench/repo --include="*.ts"
grep -rn "export type Memo" /bench/repo --include="*.ts"
```

Report exact file paths and line numbers for each layer.
